citation.authors: Verma N, Gupta SK, Tiwari S, Mishra AK

cited_by.title: Ashwagandha: cortisol, mood, skin, hair, heart, kidneys and liver

record.population: 80 healthy adults (40 men, 40 women), Lucknow, India
record.design: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled safety study, 300 mg root extract twice a day for 8 weeks
record.finding: No untoward effects in any treated volunteer. Blood counts, biochemistry including liver tests, vital signs including blood pressure, and thyroid hormones showed no significant abnormal change.
record.note: Healthy people, 8 weeks. Ethnicity not stated.
